cohort: hypothetical cohort of 100,000 term pregnancies complicated by obesity
finding: In a modelled cohort of obese women, routine induction of labour at 39 weeks was associated with fewer stillbirths, cesarean deliveries, and lower delivery-related healthcare costs compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: The study used a computational model to suggest that routine induction of labor at 39 weeks in obese pregnancies minimized cesarean delivery rates compared to expectant management.
